newsitem.title: FRANCE: Pechiney, Usinor rise on dollar gains.
newsitem.headline: Pechiney, Usinor rise on dollar gains.

text.p: Shares in Pechiney and Usinor-Sacilor rose on Wednesday, helped by the strengthening dollar and interest in cyclical stocks, market sources said.
Pechiney was up five percent at 255 francs on volume of 543,873, while Usinor traded up 2.08 percent at 81.10 on turnover of 1.66 million shares, at 1518 GMT.

SBC-Warburg reiterated its buy recommendation on Pechiney, while Dupont Denant upgraded on Tuesday the stock to outperform from underperform, citing dollar appreciation and aluminium prices as positive factors, the sources said. The stocks were also seen as catching up on the market's rise.
